title: Umbral Gem

sources.title: Gauntlet of Shar
markers: Placing the remaining three Umbral Gems

summary: Four gems operate the two Gauntlet of Shar altars.

fields.Trial gems: One each from Soft-Step, Self-Same and Faith-Leap Trials. The fourth can be acquired from Yurgir’s chamber.
fields.Use: Insert one in the Pedestal of Reckoning to activate the descent platform. Place the other three in the lower altar to open the final door. Knock can open that door directly.
fields.Inspiration: Using all four in their sockets grants Dark Machinations to Guild Artisan party members.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
